results.description:
221011_15

on the ground beneath Quercus rubra. Cap finely fibrilous, barely visible, white. When hydrated after drying, it stays tough. Lammelar trama unilateral. Spores polygonal, isodiametrical 7-8.5 um with germ pore. Chielocystidia eather not prominent or not present.  Basidia with 4 spores.

identifications.body: Finaly got to look at it closely, did microscopy. By keys, could be also E. prunuloides, though this specimens looks as it could be bigger, and habitat doesn't match up. E. sinuatum closely resembles and being with Quercus is documented.
